summary: CO2 Energy Transition Corp. (SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting that on May 18, 2026, its sponsor deposited $229,700 into the trust account to extend the deadline to complete a business combination by one month, from May 22, 2026 to June 22, 2026. The sponsor also issued a convertible promissory note for the same amount. The board authorized the extension; no advisor named. Up to five further one-month extensions are possible. Watch for the June 22, 2026 deadline and risk of liquidation if no deal is announced.
